summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment and waiver agreement (Waiver Agreement) dated June 15, 2026, with holders of its senior convertible notes originally issued on February 26, 2026. The agreement adjusted the aggregate principal amount from $4,347,826 to $4,987,489 and reduced the conversion price to $0.57 per ordinary share in exchange for certain waivers. The Notes are convertible into ordinary shares per their terms. This represents a debt restructuring to address dilution and investor concessions. Watch for further amendments or shareholder dilution impact.
